title: Zambales folk protest proposed US ammo factory in Subic Bay

blocks.text: SUBIC, ZAMBALES — Holding banners bearing messages, such as “No to Ammunition Factory in Subic Bay” and “US Bases Out Now,” a local fishing community protested in the waters of Subic Bay on Saturday, opposing a proposed United States ammunition production and storage facility in the former naval base. The fluvial protest, led by the fisherfolk group Pamalakaya and joined by local fishing associations, coincided with the observance of World Fisheries Day.
